about: Bodies, status questions and machinery-of-government events that ANA (Anatomy of Government, a govukOS app being retired) held and this register does not. Nothing here is in the register yet. Each entry keeps ANA's own wording as its origin and lists the official source to read. A maintainer reads that source before any entry is added, sets the status to 'confirmed' with what the source says (read_here), and to 'added' once the register holds it and records the register id. Sources marked read_by Cadastre were read from the official directories on 4 October 2026 by another govukOS app; they are a pointer, not a reading by this register.
licence: Facts come from the sources named on each entry, under each source's own terms (Open Government Licence v3.0 for GOV.UK, gov.scot and gov.wales; Open Parliament Licence for UK Parliament pages). Notes are by this register, CC BY 4.0.
origin: ANA source file version 1794096244-f8f9; ANA fold register rows D073 (bodies) and V049 (what is new)

statuses.to-read: an official source names it; read it there before adding

statuses.confirmed: read at source by this register on the date given; ready to add or correct

entries.name: Change of Prime Minister
entries.note: Not recorded here: a change of office holder is not a change to bodies or functions, and this register names no office holders. The machinery changes that followed are ANA-E02 to ANA-E04.

entries.name: No.10 North established
entries.note: Read at both sources on 24 November 2026. The statement is dated 21 July 2026 and says the changes take practical effect that day; the fact sheet was published 22 July. Record only the change to bodies and functions, never the names of office holders.

read_here.title: Cabinet Office, Machinery of Government changes: fact sheet (published 22 July 2026)
read_here.says: No.10 North established; local economic growth and devolution strategy moves from MHCLG and local economic growth policy from HM Treasury.

read_here.title: Written statement HLWS298, 21 July 2026
read_here.says: Same transfers; MHCLG and HM Treasury keep some remaining functions; changes take practical effect from 21 July 2026.

entries.name: Office for the Prime Minister and Cabinet (OPMC) created

read_here.title: Cabinet Office, Machinery of Government changes: fact sheet (published 22 July 2026)
read_here.says: Office for the Prime Minister and the Cabinet created, housing No.10, No.10 North and core Cabinet Office functions serving the PM and Cabinet.

read_here.title: Written statement HLWS298, 21 July 2026
read_here.says: OPMC led by the Cabinet Secretary; effective 21 July 2026.

entries.note: Read at both sources on 24 November 2026. The statement is dated 21 July 2026 and says the changes take practical effect that day; the fact sheet was published 22 July. Record only the change to bodies and functions, never the names of office holders.

read_here.says: OneGov Delivery Agency to be established within the Cabinet Office family, running operational services at arm's length: Government Recruitment Service, Pensions, Shared Services, Government Car Service, Security Vetting.
